title: Canonical integral pullback/tensor coherent-counit construction
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite extension, and $f:X\to Y$ a scheme morphism with $\ell$ invertible at all points of $X$ and $Y$. Use the fixed integral operations and constructible categories of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] and the coherent reduction, tensor, inverse image and total-limit realizations of [def-pur-completed-pullback-tower-realizations]. For constructible inputs $M,N$, the coherent reduction/limit counits on their tensor and on the two pulled-back reduction systems are invertible. Define the reference comparison by applying the actual total-limit functor to the coherent pullback/tensor comparison, conjugated by these specified counits. Define $\mu^I_{f,M,N}$ by conjugating this reference comparison with the fixed integral pullback and tensor realization isomorphisms, then restricting to the full constructible subcategory. This is the existing canonicalIntegralPullbackTensor construction, extracted verbatim; no additional choice or scalar compatibility assertion is included.

source.place: Lemma 21.18.4 (Tag 07A4, label lemma-pullback-tensor-product), for the morphism of ringed topoi (X_proet, (A_{E,n})_X) -> (Y_proet, (A_{E,n})_Y); the integral, rational and Qlbar levels follow the level-by-level definitions of the operations in def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom

proof.text: The tensor counit theorem and the pullback counit theorem give the three invertible coherent counits. Uniqueness of the sequence ring map identifies its inverse-image interface with the integral comparison sequence pullback. Compose the actual total-limit images and the fixed realization isomorphisms exactly as in the existing definitions. The full subcategory restriction preserves this isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Literal extraction of the three existing declarations and the proved sequence-ring identification; no change to the constructed morphism.

    [hX : ∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [hY : ∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)] :
    (@IntegralPullbackTensorComparison l _ E _ _ _ X Y f hX hY)
